days.highlight: 主线仍为13:00已选、待付款的 Walter Peak；先核有效确认，返港后留白。停航或未确认时留镇休息，不临时追赶远程活动。
days.highlightEn: Walter Peak remains the selected 13:00 plan, with payment pending. Verify a valid confirmation and keep the return flexible. If cancelled or unconfirmed, rest in town instead of rushing to a distant activity.

alternative.title: 高强度备选 · 米尔福德巴士与游船
alternative.desc: 仅在主动改选并提前核妥场次、接送及原活动处理后考虑；官方参考单程大巴约5小时、游船1.5至2小时，须整天替换，不能与 Walter Peak 同日叠加。

alternativeEn.title: High-intensity alternative: Milford coach and cruise
alternativeEn.desc: Consider only after deliberately changing plans and checking the sailing, pickup and handling of the original activity. The operator quotes about 5 hours each way by coach and a 1.5 to 2 hour cruise. It replaces the whole day and cannot be combined with Walter Peak.

events.text: 从已确认皇后镇住宿出发前先用早餐、查出航通知并带防风层；按私下路线选择步行或驾车，驾车可选 Man Street 停车场，先核费用并带支付卡。
events.textEn: Have breakfast, check sailing messages and take a windproof layer before leaving the confirmed Queenstown stay. Choose walking or driving using your private directions. If driving, consider Man Street Car Park; check charges and bring a payment card.

events.text: 停车后只选皇后镇花园一小段或镇中心闲逛，留出坐下休息和洗手间时间；建议11:45左右收尾，饿了少量加餐，把胃口留给已选烧烤午餐。
events.textEn: After parking, choose a short section of Queenstown Gardens or a town-centre stroll, with time to sit and use the toilets. Aim to wind down around 11:45; have a small snack if needed and leave room for the selected barbecue lunch.

events.summaryEn: Reach the wharf and check in
events.text: 从镇中心步行到 Steamer Wharf 的 RealNZ Visitor Centre，建议12:30前到；出示有效确认并核对船只，最晚报到时限仍须按票券核实。
events.textEn: Walk from the town centre to the RealNZ Visitor Centre at Steamer Wharf, aiming to arrive by 12:30. Present a valid confirmation and check the vessel. The actual check-in deadline still needs to be verified against your ticket.

events.text: 保留13:00已选、待付款状态；取得有效确认后再乘 TSS Earnslaw，巡游、烧烤与农场体验的官网参考为3.5至4小时，16:30不是保证返港时间。
events.textEn: Keep the 13:00 slot as selected, payment pending. Take TSS Earnslaw only once you hold a valid confirmation. RealNZ gives a general duration of 3.5 to 4 hours for the cruise, barbecue and farm experience; 16:30 is not a guaranteed return.

events.summaryEn: Return buffer and back to the stay
events.text: 以实际返港时间开始自由休息，先上洗手间、喝水，再选咖啡或短走；若冷、累或返程延后，就取车或按私下路线回原住宿，不再加景点。
events.textEn: Start free time after the actual return to the wharf. Use the toilets and drink some water, then choose coffee or a short walk. If cold, tired or delayed, collect the car or follow your private directions back to the same stay without another stop.

events.text: 按午餐饱腹程度就近吃简餐，不专程排队；回原住宿整理次日行李、备水和早餐，私下核对钥匙归还方式，确保次日10:00前完成退房。
events.textEn: Choose a simple nearby dinner according to your appetite after lunch, without a special trip or long queue. Back at the same stay, pack for tomorrow, prepare water and breakfast, and privately check key-return instructions so checkout is complete by 10:00.

days.highlight: 白天从皇后镇经箭镇与 Crown Range 前往瓦纳卡；夜间已外出观星、拍摄星空，用户确认体验很好。10月4日晚起，10:00再去 Puzzling World。
days.highlightEn: Daytime transfer from Queenstown via Arrowtown and Crown Range to Wānaka. The night-sky photography outing is completed, with a positive experience reported by the travellers. Sleep in on 4 October before Puzzling World at 10:00.

alternative.title: 道路备选 · 经 Cromwell
alternative.desc: 遇封路、冰雪、装链准备不足或驾驶信心不足时，先核查经 Cromwell 的道路，再替换山路和 Cardrona 停留；若两条路线均不安全，先停在安全地点联系住宿，不赶16:00。

alternativeEn.title: Road alternative: via Cromwell
alternativeEn.desc: For closures, ice, inadequate chain preparation or low driving confidence, check the Cromwell route before replacing the pass and Cardrona stop. If neither route is safe, stop somewhere safe and contact the accommodation rather than chase a 16:00 arrival.

links: Crown Range 与 Cromwell 选择
linksEn: QLDC alpine roads and chain checks

events.text: 10:00前完成原住宿退房和钥匙交接，行李装妥再出发；早餐时查 QLDC 与 NZTA 路况，备水、离线地图及燃油余量，按私下路线驶向箭镇。
events.textEn: Complete checkout and key return at the Queenstown stay by 10:00, then leave with luggage secured. Over breakfast, check QLDC and NZTA updates, water, offline maps and fuel, then follow your private directions towards Arrowtown.

events.text: 抵达箭镇后按现场标牌停车，把行李收进后备箱、贵重物随身；旧街区慢走约45分钟后午餐和休息，13:00前回车旁，晚到就缩短闲逛。
events.textEn: Park in Arrowtown according to posted restrictions; put luggage out of sight and keep valuables with you. Plan roughly 45 minutes in the old streets, then lunch and a seated rest. Return to the car before 13:00, shortening the walk if arrival is late.

events.summaryEn: Choose the transfer route for conditions
events.text: 出发前再查 Crown Range 通行及装链要求；路况合适且有把握才上山，封路、结冰或未备好链就改经 Cromwell，并先确认备选道路可通行。
events.textEn: Recheck Crown Range access and chain requirements before leaving. Use the pass only in suitable conditions and with a confident driver. If closed, icy or you are not equipped for required chains, choose Cromwell after checking that route is also passable.

events.summaryEn: Viewpoint stop only if conditions allow
events.text: 仅在路面干燥、视线良好且能安全进入正规停车位时短停；建议拍照约10分钟就继续下山，余量留给慢速驾驶；若改走 Cromwell，本段用于行车与休息。
events.textEn: Stop only if the surface is dry, visibility is good and you can safely enter a proper parking area. Allow about 10 minutes for photos, then continue downhill, keeping the remaining time for unhurried driving. On the Cromwell alternative, use this block for driving and rest.

events.summaryEn: Cardrona break, then continue to town
events.text: 下山后可在 Cardrona Hotel 按现场指示停车，喝咖啡、上洗手间，建议控制在30分钟再驶向瓦纳卡；若排队、疲劳或已绕行 Cromwell，就跳过此站。
events.textEn: After descending, optionally park as signed at Cardrona Hotel for coffee and the toilets. Aim to leave within 30 minutes and continue to Wānaka. Skip this stop if queues, tiredness or the Cromwell alternative make it inconvenient.

events.summaryEn: Park and settle at the stay
events.text: 16:00是计划到达，不是确认可入住时刻；到已确认瓦纳卡住宿先按指示停车、核对入住并卸行李，休息后就近简餐，入住窗口与停车安排仍待确认。
events.textEn: 16:00 is the planned arrival, not a verified check-in time. At the confirmed Wānaka stay, follow parking instructions, check in and unload, then rest before a nearby simple meal. The arrival window and parking arrangements still need confirmation.

events.text: 用户确认在当时聊天后外出，拍了半个多小时后返回，体验很好。依据当时所说的22:30及本次补充，暂记10月3日约22:30—23:10；这是回忆估计时段，不是精确拍摄或返程时间，具体机位未记录。活动已完成。
events.textEn: The travellers went out after the conversation, photographed the night sky for a little over half an hour, then returned and reported a good experience. Based on the stated 22:30 time and this clarification, record approximately 22:30–23:10 on 3 October. This is a recalled time window, not exact photography or return timestamps; the shooting spot was not recorded. The activity is completed.

days.highlight: 观星后晚起，10:00玩 Puzzling World，中午回瓦纳卡吃饭，下午慢游 Lake Hāwea 南岸；回住宿休息、晚餐后再去湖中树，不叠加 Mount Iron。
days.highlightEn: Sleep in after stargazing, visit Puzzling World at 10:00, return to Wānaka for lunch and spend the afternoon by Lake Hāwea's southern shore. Rest at the stay and have dinner before the evening tree stop; do not add Mount Iron.

alternative.title: 雨天或低体力 · 室内与休息
alternative.desc: 雨天上午只玩 Puzzling World 室内区；下午若风雨大或仍困倦，取消 Hāwea 和 Albert Town，留在瓦纳卡休息。傍晚湖中树也可缩短，不补爬山。

alternativeEn.title: Rain or low energy: indoors and rest
alternativeEn.desc: In rain, choose only Puzzling World's indoor rooms in the morning. If wind, rain or fatigue persists, skip Hāwea and Albert Town and rest in Wānaka. Shorten the evening tree stop too; do not replace it with a climb.

links: 湖岸与湖中树路线参考
Wānaka 与 Lake Hāwea 官方路线参考
linksEn: Official Wānaka and Lake Hāwea route reference

events.text: 睡醒吃过早餐，从原住宿出发，目标10:00到 Puzzling World；先看错觉馆，再按体力玩迷宫，约12:00收尾。官网4月至11月09:00开门、16:30最后入场；这是建议游览时段，不是已预订门票。玩到12:30也可，午餐和下午顺延。
events.textEn: After sleeping in and having breakfast, leave the same stay and aim to reach Puzzling World at 10:00. Start with the illusion rooms, then try the maze if you feel up to it, aiming to finish around noon. The official April-November hours list opening at 09:00 and last admission at 16:30. This is a suggested visit, not a ticket booking. Finishing at 12:30 is fine; shift lunch and the afternoon back.

events.text: 目标12:15左右回瓦纳卡镇上坐下吃午餐，留到13:30，不急着赶路；实际离园、停车和上菜较慢就顺延。补水后检查精神状态，仍困倦就取消下午开车，回原住宿休息。
events.textEn: Aim to sit down for lunch back in Wānaka around 12:15 and take until 13:30. Shift this later if leaving the attraction, parking or food takes longer. Refill water and check alertness; if still sleepy, skip the afternoon drive and rest at the same stay.

events.text: 午餐后经 Albert Town 前往 Lake Hāwea 镇与南岸，预留30分钟作驾驶、找路和停车缓冲，不是实时车程承诺。以 Capell Avenue 一带为目的地区域，按现场标牌选择合法停车，不在公路边临停拍照。
events.textEn: After lunch, drive via Albert Town to Lake Hāwea township and its southern shore. The 30-minute block is a planning allowance for driving, navigation and parking, not a live ETA. Aim for the Capell Avenue area, use signed legal parking and avoid roadside photo stops.

events.text: 把下午重点留给 Lake Hāwea 南岸：从镇旁可进入的湖岸短走、坐一会儿、拍湖与山，不要求走完整条步道，也不继续绕到 The Neck。风大就缩短；需要咖啡可现场查看 Hawea Store & Kitchen 是否营业，未核验当日营业或座位。
events.textEn: Make Lake Hāwea's southern shore the afternoon focus: take a short walk from an accessible town-side lakefront spot, sit and photograph the lake and mountains. There is no need to complete a full trail or continue to The Neck. Shorten the stop if windy. Check Hawea Store & Kitchen locally if you want coffee; that day's opening and seats have not been verified.

events.summaryEn: Return drive with an optional stop
events.text: 约16:00离开湖岸，沿原方向返回瓦纳卡；经过 Albert Town 时有精神可停20至30分钟看看 Clutha River，找不到合适停车或天冷就直接略过。17:00回住宿是计划目标，不是实时到达保证。
events.textEn: Leave the lakefront around 16:00 and return towards Wānaka. If alert and comfortable, take an optional 20-30 minute stop in Albert Town to see the Clutha River; skip it if parking is unsuitable or it is cold. Reaching the stay at 17:00 is a planning target, not a live arrival guarantee.

events.summaryEn: Rest and pack at the stay
events.text: 回同一家住宿休息一小时，换保暖衣服、整理明早行李；今天不加 Mount Iron，保留观星后补觉和恢复体力的余地。
events.textEn: Rest for an hour at the same accommodation, change into warmer clothes and prepare tomorrow's luggage. Do not add Mount Iron today; leave room to recover after the late stargazing night.

events.text: 18:00左右在镇上或原住宿吃晚餐，不为等湖边光线拖晚吃饭；备好明早早餐与饮水，19:00后留出前往湖中树和停车的时间。
events.textEn: Have dinner in town or at the same stay around 18:00 rather than delaying food for the evening light. Prepare breakfast and water for tomorrow, then allow time after 19:00 to reach the tree and park.

events.summaryEn: Evening tree stop and a short walk
events.text: 约19:15再到 That Wanaka Tree 与 Roys Bay 西端湖岸，按现场天光和体力短走拍照，目标20:15收尾；这个时段不是核验后的日落时刻。只在岸上拍照，不涉水；回房后准备休息，保留10月5日08:45出发去库克山的安排。
events.textEn: Return to That Wānaka Tree and western Roys Bay around 19:15 for a short walk and photos, adjusting to the light and energy levels and aiming to finish by 20:15. This is not a verified sunset time. Stay on shore without wading, then return to rest. Keep the planned 08:45 departure for Mount Cook on 5 October.
